options.systemMessage:
=Read the following call transcript and metadata from a restaurant voice assistant and extract these fields as JSON.
If a field does not apply to this call type, return an empty string.

Fields to extract:
- call_id: extract from metadata below
- timestamp: extract from metadata below
- duration_secs: extract from metadata below
- call_cost: extract from metadata below
- ended_reason: extract from metadata below
- recording_url: extract from metadata below
- record_type: one of "order", "reservation", or "escalation"
- customer_name
- customer_phone: convert all spoken words to digits e.g. "zero eight one zero eight nine three eight one seven two" = "08108938172". Never leave empty if a number was spoken anywhere.
- order_type: "delivery" or "pickup". Only for orders. Empty otherwise.
- delivery_area: neighbourhood for delivery. Empty if pickup or not an order.
- delivery_fee: number in naira. 500 for Wuse 2/Maitama/Asokoro/Central Area. 800 for Garki/Utako/Jabi/Wuse 1. 1200 for Gwarinpa/Lugbe/Kubwa/Karu/Nyanya. 0 if pickup. Empty if not an order.
- order_items: comma-separated list of all items ordered including size and protein. Empty if not an order.
- order_total: subtotal in naira excluding delivery fee. Empty if not an order.
- grand_total: order_total plus delivery_fee. Empty if not an order.
- pickup_time: time for collection, convert casual speech e.g. "five PM" = "5:00 PM". Empty if delivery or not an order.
- payment_method: "transfer" or "cash". Empty if not an order.
- special_instructions: customisation requests e.g. extra pepper, no onions. Empty if not an order.
- party_size: number of guests, must be 5 or more. Only for reservations. Empty otherwise.
- reservation_date: date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Only for reservations. Empty otherwise.
- reservation_time: arrival time e.g. "1:00 PM". Only for reservations. Empty otherwise.
- deposit_status: always "pending" if reservation was taken. Empty otherwise.
- special_requests: extra notes for reservation e.g. occasion, dietary needs. Only for reservations. Empty otherwise.
- escalation_reason: "unanswered_question" or "complaint". Only for escalations. Empty otherwise.
- caller_request: what the caller asked or complained about in one sentence. Only for escalations. Empty otherwise.
- agent_note: why Teni could not resolve the issue. Only for escalations. Empty otherwise.
- resolved: false if this is an escalation. Empty otherwise.
- status: "new" for orders, "pending_deposit" for reservations, "needs_callback" for escalations.
- agent_summary: one sentence summary of the entire call regardless of type.

Rules:
1. Never leave customer_phone empty if a number was spoken anywhere in the transcript.
2. Never leave order_type empty if the caller mentioned delivery or pickup.
3. Never leave pickup_time empty if a time was mentioned for collection.
4. Convert ALL spoken numbers to digits.
5. Extract call_id, timestamp, duration_secs, call_cost, ended_reason and recording_url strictly from the metadata — do not guess.
6. Return ONLY valid JSON with exactly these 30 keys. No explanation, no markdown, no backticks.

Metadata:
call_id: {{ $json.body.message.call.id }}
timestamp: {{ $json.body.message.startedAt }}
duration_secs: {{ $json.body.message.durationSeconds }}
call_cost: {{ $json.body.message.cost }}
ended_reason: {{ $json.body.message.endedReason }}
recording_url: {{ $json.body.message.artifact.recordingUrl }}

Transcript:
{{ $json.body.message.artifact.transcript }}
